ST-Standard ICE-07 RGB High-Performance Gaming Laptop Cooling Pad (6-Fan Powerful Cooling Array / Dynamic RGB Accent Lighting / Digital LCD Display Panel / Multi-Angle Ergonomic Stand / Dual USB Ports / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Keep your gaming laptop operating at peak thermal efficiency with the ST-Standard ICE-07 RGB High-Performance Gaming Laptop Cooling Pad, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a comprehensive 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Engineered with a heavy-duty iron mesh surface and an impact-resistant ABS frame chassis, this cooling stand is optimized to support laptops up to 17 Inch display formats seamlessly. Powered by an advanced 6-fan active thermal layout, it delivers consistent high-volume airflow across major hardware exhaust zones to suppress thermal throttling during extended gaming or rendering workloads. The pad features dynamic RGB side accent lighting setups to complement your gaming environment aesthetics. Equipped with an integrated LCD digital control screen for real-time fan power adjustment, ergonomic height elevation angles, and dual USB pass-through ports, this low-noise cooler provides complete operational stability.
